newsitem.title: UK: LPC-Kazakstan steel firm Ispat gets $45 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Kazakstan steel firm Ispat gets $45 mln loan.

text.p: LONDON, Feb 26 (LPC) - Kazakhstan steel producer Ispat Karmat JSC has taken a $45 million syndicated loan, arranger ABN AMRO Bank Kazakstan announced.
The revolving credit is said to be the first syndicated loan to the Kazakstan private sector and will be used by Ispat as working capital.
Participants in the deal are ABN AMRO Bank, Credit Suisse First Boston, JP Morgan, Royal Bank of Canada and Sumitomo Bank.
ABN AMRO Kazakstan is a joint venture of ABN AMRO Bank, KazKommertsbank and International Finance Corporation.
Ispat Karmat, the largest steel producer in the former Soviet Union, is part of London-based Ispat International.
